title: I CAN SAY IT WAS MY BEST TASTE.
text:
Highly, highly recommended. Montse explains it passionately and any question he is asked answers with a smile every time.
It is the first visit and tasting I have really enjoyed and learned.

author: CEJA2

title: Everything was very interesting, good wines and even better personal treatment, 👍👏
text:
Everything was fantastic. A hotel experience with a spa and a winery visit.
After an initial problem with the day's programming, they resolved it very well. We had a guide just for us, and he was superb. The visits were very interesting, with Lluva's explanations (sorry, I don't remember her name well), her passion for her work and her power of transmission. We are very grateful to the owner for sorting out the scheduling problem, to the guide, and to the lady who kept the winery open for us.
 Recommended by all 😃👍
author: F5460HYanap

title: Visit a large winery
text: The guided tour was spectacular, the guide did wonderfully a very professional and friendly man, the small cellar but a large cellar and the exceptional tasting room. The delicious wines also offer a wide variety of wines both red and white , I recommend 100% this experience to enjoy if you are passionate about wine and mountains , finally the winery is close to Barcelona.

title: Nice experience and good wines

title: Visit winery + course and tasting
text: The visit was ideal, Nestor Gracia (enologist) was very friendly and explained everything clearly. Very interesting tasting and good wines. I recommend it 100%.
author: I6320DZlydias

title: Best wine class we've ever done in a winery.
text:
You can tell when there are people who love the work they do and what they do.
We have made this visit through a pack of experiences and we have been accompanied by Nestor, winemaker of the winery, who has made a visit to the farm / winery and the vineyard. Enthusiastically explaining the history of the winery and the history of Catalan winemaking and winemaking, curiosities of the world and with a spectacular wine tasting class. A highly recommended experience as well as its wines and that employees like Nestor convey so well the love for wine and its profession.

title: Recommended
